Chemical Agents is a Premium Warbond available for 1,000 Super Credits in the Warbonds tab of the Acquisition Center.

Contents

  • 1 Overview
  • 2 Contents
    • 2.1 Page 1
    • 2.2 Page 2
    • 2.3 Page 3
  • 3 Media

  • 5 Change History

Overview

Players can use Medals to claim various items, including 2 weapons, stratagems, and armors, 6 cosmetics, and 300 Super Credits. These rewards are spread across three pages, each requiring increasingly more Medals (ranging from 2 to 110). Players start on page one, unlocking subsequent pages as they spend more Medals, gradually expanding their customization options.

Contents

Different types of weapons than in previous Warbonds—namely, two stratagems and a supportive secondary—with no booster.

  • Sterilizer sprays caustic gas while holding down the trigger.
  • “Guard Dog” Dog Breath is a drone that flies near its backpack carrier and sprays nearby enemies with gas.
  • The stim pistol can hit fellow Helldivers with stims from afar.
  • The G-4 Gas releases a cloud of gas after a 2.9 second fuse time.
  • The body armors provide you with gas resistance.
